objectives: Trace the direct lineage of Adam and explain who the sons of God are.
Explain what it means that Enoch walked with God and was not.
Work out how long Noah preached before the flood.
takeaways: The daily reading gives faith through hearing the word of the Most High (Romans 10:17).
Chapter 5 is the direct lineage of Adam; that lineage is the sons of God of chapter 6, and it runs through Shem to Israel.
Male and female created he them were the other people on the earth; the first Adam was made in the likeness of God.
Enoch did not taste death; the Most High took him up, as Elijah was taken up (2 Kings 2:9-11).
Noah was 500 here and 600 at the flood, so he preached around a hundred years.
